claims: The Apple AirPods Pro 3 were released in Sept 2025.
The Apple AirPods Pro 3 are priced at $249.
The Apple AirPods Pro 3 feature an H2 chip.
The Apple AirPods Pro 3 include heart rate monitoring.
The Apple AirPods Pro 3 offer ~8 hours of listening time.
The Apple AirPods Pro 3 have IP57 dust/water resistance.
The Apple AirPods Pro 3 have built-in sensors that allow for heart rate tracking during workouts.
The Apple AirPods Pro 3 feature "4x better" ANC than the original AirPods Pro.
The Apple AirPods Pro 3 have a "3rd generation" acoustic design.
The Apple AirPods Pro 3 include an in-ear hearing test.
The Apple AirPods Pro 3 include an updated "Hearing Aid" feature.
The Apple AirPods Pro 3 include automatic conversation boost.
The Apple AirPods Pro 3 feature redesigned ear tips with 5 size options.
The Apple AirPods Pro 3 offer up to 8 hours of listening time on one charge with ANC.
The Apple AirPods Pro 3 use the H2 chip for enhanced spatial audio and adaptive audio functionality.
The Apple AirPods Pro 3 were originally priced at $249.
Recent sales have reduced the Apple AirPods Pro 3 to $199.
The Apple AirPods Pro 3 are designed primarily for Apple devices (iOS/macOS).
The Apple AirPods Pro 3 work with other Bluetooth devices.
Some advanced features of the Apple AirPods Pro 3 may not be available on other Bluetooth devices.
The case of the Apple AirPods Pro 3 is slightly larger than the previous generation.
The case of the Apple AirPods Pro 3 does not have a button on the back.
